source: Provincial Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Pursat Province — សារធាតុចិញ្ចឹមសម្រាប់ដំណាំស្រូវ (Nutrients for the Rice Crop), presenter Yem Sophy, 20 Nov 2017, p.10
text: Combining Urea, DAP, and potassium chloride (Kali/MOP) fertilizers together (rather than using a single nutrient source alone) helps the rice crop achieve high yield.
